title: Dahisar East: Line 2A / Red Line interchange and Line 9 continuity

findings.claim: One mapped Dahisar East station location is identified as the Red-to-Yellow interchange.

evidence.name: Dahisar (East)
evidence.remarks: Elevated, Interchange between Red to Yellow

findings.claim: The L2A design treats Dahisar East as a special two-corridor station, with a platform assigned to each corridor.
findings.evidence: One platform is for the Dahisar East–Andheri corridor (Line 7); the other is for the Dahisar East–D.N. Nagar corridor (Line 2A). This identifies corridor allocation only; it does not establish platform number, direction labels, current passenger route, or as-built levels.

findings.claim: The MMRDA EIA places the Line 2A platform above the already proposed Line 7 Dahisar East station.
findings.evidence: The EIA describes the Line 2A station starting at Western Express Highway and its platform located above the already proposed Dahisar East metro station for the Andheri East–Dahisar corridor.
findings.limits: Relative design position only; no verified absolute floor labels, elevations, current passenger entrance path, or platform numbering.

findings.claim: Line 9 extends the Red Line beyond the existing Dahisar East Line 7 station; it is not a third interchange movement at Dahisar.
findings.evidence: The DPR describes the alignment as extending beyond Dahisar East station under implementation; Pandurang Wadi is the next station on the extension.

findings.claim: Line 9 Phase I is reported operational from Dahisar East to Kashigaon with four stations.
MMRDA explicitly identifies Dahisar East as an interchange joining Line 2A and Line 7.
findings.caution: The announcement's three-tier station statement describes Meditiya Nagar, not Dahisar East.

canonicalInterpretation.physicalTransfer: Line 2A ↔ Red Line (Line 7/9 service); do not create a separate Line 7 ↔ Line 9 transfer edge.
canonicalInterpretation.line9StationEntity: No separate Dahisar Line 9 CTM station row is invented; MMRDA describes Line 9 as an extension beyond the existing Dahisar East Line 7 station.
canonicalInterpretation.levelResolution: The DPRs establish proposed corridor/platform layout but not sufficient verified as-built level detail for the level refresh script. Preserve levels as unknown pending current station-layout/as-built evidence.

openOperationalEvidence: Current signed passenger wayfinding/platform labels and platform numbering
As-built levels and exact vertical circulation at the Line 2A/Red Line connection
Measured accessible transfer route, distance, and typical walking time
Paid/unpaid boundary, AFC retap rule, and security rescreening instructions
Station-specific accessibility confirmation for a continuous step-free route

sourceAcquisitionLead.use: Potentially corroborates current station arrangement and retail/public-area locations; treat as an operator-issued tender drawing, not automatically as an as-built engineering drawing.
